claims.text: The rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08(a) is met: the trip record, the GPS trace and the fare breakdown all carry trip_id TRP-02807, and the trace's first fix at 2026-08-21T13:24:42+08:00 matches the trip record's trip_started event to the second, so the three artifacts describe this trip and no other.

The trace is unimpaired for policy purposes: 133 fixes at a 10-second sampling interval, 100.0% coverage, no gaps and max_gap_sec of 0.0, so none of POL-RD-07(a), (b) or (c) fires, no independent corroboration is needed, and the trace_distance_km of 16.91 km governs the POL-RD-01 threshold test in place of the trip record's rounded 16.9 km convenience copy.

On the governing trace the excess is 1.81 km - 16.91 km measured against the booked optimal of 15.1 km - which is more than twice the 0.8 km absolute limb in POL-RD-01; the rider's distance loss is a real and measured overrun, not a rounding artefact.

The rider is not the serial-claimant profile POL-RD-08 contemplates: rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 0 and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0, so the additional corroboration-beyond-the-trace requirement in the closing sentence of POL-RD-08 is not engaged and this claim is judged on this trip's own trace.

Nothing on this record exonerates the 1.81 km, and the finding should not rest on an excuse the bundle does not carry: the chat log holds 0 messages, so no rider-requested detour under POL-RD-04 can be shown; pickup_amended_at, dropoff_amended_at and amended_optimal_distance_km are all null, so POL-RD-05 cannot be run; and the only advisory artifact, EV-ADVIS-02807-01, is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, so its absence cannot support a POL-RD-03 exoneration for a closure no record describes. The rider discloses that artifact's impairment and does not present it as clean evidence.

The driver's answer, 'I followed the navigation', is a bare assertion: it names no evidence id, the chat log records no message from him, and he cites no advisory; under POL-RD-08 an assertion that cites no evidence ID carries no weight, and under POL-RD-13 an uncited traffic-side excuse is not the POL-RD-10(5) contradiction of a cited artifact - the absent advisory is a gap in the bundle, not a competing account - so his statement supplies neither an exoneration nor an amended optimal.

The rider concedes the second establishment limb rather than argue around it: the excess is 11.99% of the 15.1 km booked optimal, below the 20% limb, and POL-RD-01 requires the excess to exceed both 20% of the optimal and 0.8 km in absolute terms, so on this record no deviation is established and the POL-RD-02 recomputation does not open. The rider's point is not that the 20% gate should be read differently, only that the 1.81 km itself is measured, undisputed and unexonerated.

Recorded only so the size of the sum in issue is visible on the face of the brief, and not asked for on this record: had the POL-RD-01 gate been met, POL-RD-02 on this METERED fare would give recomputed_fare 21.637 against charged_total 23.44, a refund of 1.8030 rounded up to 1.85 - above the 0.50 de minimis and far below the 90% full-refund share - with the surge_multiplier of 1.0 read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier and not from the trip record.

claims.text: POL-RD-01 requires BOTH establishment tests to pass: the excess must be greater than 20% of the optimal route AND greater than 0.8 km in absolute terms. On the governing trace figure the excess is 1.81 km against a 15.1 km optimal route, which is 11.99% — well short of the 20% gate. The percentage test fails, so no route deviation is established on this trip, however the rider characterises it.

The rider's own pleaded figures — 16.91 km driven against a 15.1 km optimal — produce exactly the same 1.81 km excess and therefore the same 11.99%, below the 20% gate; the claim fails on the numbers the rider himself supplied. POL-RD-01 further provides that where gps_trace.trace_distance_km and trip_record.actual_distance_km disagree, the trace figure governs and the trip_record copy (16.9 km) may NOT be cited for the threshold test; on either figure the excess is sub-threshold.

Where either establishment test fails, POL-RD-01 states that no deviation exists and the outcome is NO_ACTION however the rider characterises the trip. The clause preserves only one residual route on such a finding — a billing-integrity refund under POL-RD-09(4) — and that route yields nothing on this fare, as the next claim shows.

The trace from which the excess is measured is unimpaired and cannot be attacked on integrity: 133 fixes at a 10 s sample interval, 100.0% coverage, max_gap_sec 0.0 and an empty gaps array, admissibility COMPLETE at weight 1.0. POL-RD-07(a) to (c) is not engaged — there is no gap above 90 s, no straight-line jump above 500 m and no sustained sampling interval above 30 s — so no corroboration question arises and the measured excess stands as the best evidence of the route actually driven.

POL-RD-08 places the initial burden on the rider to show an excess meeting the POL-RD-01 threshold, measured from an unimpaired gps_trace. The rider has shown no such excess and the unimpaired trace shows none, so the burden is never discharged and the driver is never put to an exculpatory clause at all. An assertion that cites no evidence ID carrying a qualifying excess carries no weight.

There is no billing-integrity correction to make on this fare and so the single route POL-RD-01 leaves open on a sub-threshold trip returns the rider nothing: fare_breakdown carries tolls_erp 0.00, zero erp_gantries, no airport surcharge and waiting_time_fee 0.00, and the ledger lines reconcile exactly to total_charged 23.44 (base fare 3.80 + distance fare 12.68 + time fare 6.16 + platform fee 0.80). No gantry is charged that the trace never crosses, and no surcharge is applied that the trip does not attract.

The POL-RD-06 driver-profile check is not even triggered: that clause is consulted only on a MATERIAL deviation — excess over 50% of optimal or over 8.0 km — or where the evidence is finely balanced, and 1.81 km / 11.99% is neither. Were it consulted, the named counters show no pattern on either limb: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0, below the threshold of 3, and 0 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_90d (350) is 0.00, below the 0.05 ratio. No reputation-based uplift or referral is available against this driver on this record.

No POL-RD-10 escalation trigger fires: trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown all carry trip TRP-02807; the trace is unimpaired so POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged; no timestamps disagree by more than 10 minutes or run backwards; no charge line lacks a counterpart anywhere in the trace or trip record (there are no ERP or surcharge lines at all); the computed refund is nil and far below the SGD 150.00 ceiling; and the two sides are not supported by mutually contradictory admissible evidence of comparable strength. This is an ordinary sub-threshold case to be ruled on the merits, not held for a human.

The chat_log holds zero messages for this trip: the rider gave the driver no instruction and raised no complaint contemporaneously, and the record carries no waypoint_hint on which a rider-requested detour under POL-RD-04 could ever be built. The driver's account — that he followed the navigation — is the only contemporaneous statement in the bundle and nothing in the artifacts contradicts it.

No traffic_advisory covers this trip window. I disclose that EV-ADVIS-02807-01 is impaired: it is MISSING, carries weight_multiplier 0.0 and fires the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, so it can carry no fact. Its absence is nonetheless citable, and under POL-RD-13 it is a gap in the bundle rather than a contradiction in it: the driver does not assert an external traffic cause — his statement is that he followed the navigation — so no exculpatory clause is invoked against a missing artifact and POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged by it.

NO_ACTION is party-relative under POL-GEN-03: it means the filing party's claim is not supported and the present state stands, leaving fare_breakdown.payment_status and refund_issued_sgd exactly as they are. The rider filed this dispute and payment_status is CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so NO_ACTION simply leaves the metered fare as collected and moves no money — it creates no charge against the driver and restores nothing to the rider.

ruling.explanation: To the rider and to the driver: the trip's own GPS trace governs the distance question, and it measures 16.91 km against the platform's booked optimal route of 15.1 km — an excess of 1.81 km. POL-RD-01 establishes a route deviation only when the excess exceeds both 0.8 km in absolute terms and 20% of the optimal route. The 1.81 km clears the absolute limb but is only 11.99% of 15.1 km, below the 20% gate, and both tests must pass. No route deviation is therefore established on this trip however the trip is characterised. The rider's own figures (16.91 km against 15.1 km) produce the same 1.81 km and the same 11.99%, and the rider's submission expressly concedes this limb rather than contesting it; that concession is accepted. The driver's submission that the percentage gate fails is also accepted, and the governing figure is the trace's 16.91 km, not the trip record's rounded 16.9 km convenience copy, so the reading is the one most favourable to the driver. The trace is unimpaired: 133 fixes at a 10-second sampling interval, 100.0% coverage, no gaps and max_gap_sec 0.0, admissibility COMPLETE at weight 1.0, so none of POL-RD-07(a) to (c) fires, no corroboration question arises, and the measurement stands. Because the gate fails, the POL-RD-02 recomputation does not open; for transparency, had it opened on this METERED fare it would have given a recomputed fare of 21.637 against a charged total of 23.44, a refund of 1.85 — but no refund is available. The one route POL-RD-01 leaves open on a sub-threshold trip is a billing-integrity correction under POL-RD-09(4), and there is none to make: the fare ledger shows tolls/ERP of 0.00, no ERP gantries, no airport surcharge and a waiting-time fee of 0.00, and its lines reconcile exactly to the charged total of 23.44 (base fare 3.80 + distance fare 12.68 + time fare 6.16 + platform fee 0.80). No charge line lacks a counterpart in the trace. The POL-RD-06 driver-profile check is not triggered — this is neither a MATERIAL deviation nor finely balanced evidence — and even if consulted the citable counters show no pattern (0 deviation flags in 90 days; 0 of 350 completed trips). The chat log holds 0 messages, so no rider-requested detour under POL-RD-04 can be shown, waypoint_hint is absent, and no pickup or dropoff amendment under POL-RD-05 exists. The only traffic advisory in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-02807-01, is MISSING at weight_multiplier 0.0 with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT; the driver has not asserted an external traffic cause, so the missing advisory carries nothing and, under POL-RD-13, engages no POL-RD-10(5) escalation. No POL-RD-10 trigger fires at all: the three artifacts all carry trip TRP-02807, the trace is unimpaired, the timestamps agree, no charge line is unmatched, and the refund computed is nil and far below the 150.00 ceiling. Nor is any driver compensation due under POL-RD-04: the fare was billed on 16.9 km against a trace of 16.91 km, a shortfall of 0.01 km, well under the 1.0 km threshold. The outcome is NO_ACTION, which under POL-GEN-03 is party-relative: this dispute was filed by the rider, payment_status is CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00, and the metered fare of 23.44 stands as collected. No money moves, so nothing is held for execution under POL-GEN-05. One claim advanced on the rider's behalf was discarded before I ruled — it cited the missing advisory without naming its issue codes, which POL-GEN-02(1) requires; it is recorded in the audit trail below. The driver's statement that he followed the navigation is not relied on either way: the outcome rests on the measured trace and the clause threshold, not on his account or on any excuse. Confidence is 0.95, above the 0.70 floor; the deciding facts (trace distance 16.91 km and booked optimal 15.1 km) are carried by EV-GPS-02807 and EV-TRIP-02807, both at full weight 1.0. This ruling is provisional and may be appealed once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

Rider, your claim is not supported on this record; Driver, no finding is made against you.

The governing trace figure (EV-GPS-02807) is 16.91 km against the booked optimal of 15.1 km (EV-TRIP-02807): an excess of 1.81 km, which is 11.99% of the optimal. The absolute limb is cleared (1.81 km > 0.8 km) but the percentage limb is not (11.99% < 20%). On the governing trace figure no route deviation is therefore established, and POL-RD-01 directs NO_ACTION however the trip is characterised. Your own pleaded figures (16.91 km against 15.1 km) produce exactly the same result. Where the trace figure (16.91) and the trip record's rounded convenience copy (16.9) differ, the trace governs and I have used it; the trip-record copy may not be cited for the threshold test.

I have checked the only route POL-RD-01 leaves open on a sub-threshold trip — a billing-integrity correction under POL-RD-09(4). The fare breakdown (EV-FARE-02807) carries zero ERP lines, no airport surcharge and a waiting-time fee of 0.00, and its lines reconcile exactly to the charged total of SGD 23.44 (base fare 3.80 + distance charge 12.68 + time charge 6.16 + platform fee 0.80). No gantry is charged that the trace never crossed and no surcharge is applied that this trip does not attract, so that route returns nothing either. The refund figure of SGD 1.85 you recorded had the first gate been met is noted; because the gate fails, the POL-RD-02 recomputation never opens.

The trace is unimpaired: 133 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, no gaps and max_gap_sec 0.0, so none of POL-RD-07(a) to (c) fires and the measured excess stands as the best evidence of the route driven — it is simply below the establishment gate. No exculpatory clause changes the outcome and none is needed: the chat log (EV-CHAT-02807) holds zero messages, so no rider-requested detour under POL-RD-04 exists; pickup_amended_at, dropoff_amended_at and amended_optimal_distance_km are all null, so POL-RD-05 cannot be run; and EV-ADVIS-02807-01 is MISSING, carries weight 0.0 and fires issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, so its absence cannot support a POL-RD-03 exoneration for a closure no record describes. Neither party invoked that absent advisory as an excuse, so POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged by it; the absence is a gap in the bundle, not a contradiction in it. The driver's statement that he followed the navigation cites no evidence ID and asserts no external traffic cause; under POL-RD-08 it carries no weight either way, and it does not move the arithmetic.

No escalation trigger fires: the trip identifiers match across trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown; the trace is unimpaired so POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged; no timestamps disagree by more than 10 minutes or run backwards; no charge line lacks a counterpart; and no two admissible sides are in contradictory evidence of comparable strength. This is an ordinary sub-threshold case, decided on the merits rather than held. The POL-RD-06 driver-profile check is not reached — there is no material deviation, and in any event driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 (below 3) and 0 divided by completed_trips_90d of 350 is 0.00 (below 0.05) — so no conduct referral is produced, and no other clause produces a referral on these facts.

Outcome: NO_ACTION. The metered fare of SGD 23.44 stands as charged; no amount is refunded to the rider and no compensation is paid to the driver. The monetary effect is nil, below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so nothing is held. Confidence is 0.95, resting on the GPS trace and the trip record, both at weight 1.0.
